# Hotel Paxmontana

I can share what I know about this historic Swiss hotel:

## Location & History
Hotel Paxmontana is located in Flüeli-Ranft, near Sachseln in the canton of Obwalden, Switzerland. It sits in the hills above Lake Sarnen with views of the surrounding mountains.

## Historical Significance
The hotel has an interesting connection to **peace history**:
- It was the site of an international peace conference in 1905
- The conference brought together pacifists and peace activists from various countries
- This gathering was part of the early 20th-century international peace movement, occurring during a period of growing tensions that would eventually lead to WWI

## The Building
- Built in a traditional Swiss style typical of Alpine hotels from that era
- Located in an area known for its spiritual significance (near the hermitage of St. Nicholas of Flüe, Switzerland's patron saint)
- The setting provides panoramic views of the Swiss Alps

## Current Status
The hotel has operated as a conference center and hotel, though its current operational status and exact offerings may have changed over the years.

The name "Paxmontana" itself combines "Pax" (Latin for peace) with "Montana" (mountain), reflecting both its location and its historical association with the peace movement.
